records.rationale: Describes conventional data and application services for discovering location-specific information and taking business action; no AI functionality is indicated.
evidence_spans: quickly discover location-specific insight and then take immediate action

records.rationale: The description specifies conventional mapping functions: imagery, street views, traffic display, maps and route planning.
evidence_spans: real-time traffic conditions, and route planning for traveling by foot, car, bicycle and air, or public transportation.

records.rationale: This is described as a mapping service for directions, traffic, trip planning and imagery, conventional geographic information functions.
evidence_spans: Map multiple locations, get transit/walking/driving directions, view live traffic conditions, plan trips, view satellite, aerial and street side imagery.

records.rationale: The text describes a conventional geographic reference dataset of boundaries, wire centers, area codes and carriers.
evidence_spans: geographic boundary data, including information about wire centers, area codes, and the major local exchange carriers (LEC) operating in each LATA.

records.rationale: The description only situates the application within an address-quality solution and gives no operational details; best forced judgment is conventional address-quality software.
evidence_spans: Part of the Enterprise Address Quality Solution.

records.rationale: Describes street-level visual imagery and navigation using visible landmarks as cues, conventional mapping and travel-planning functions.
evidence_spans: Travel along streets, view storefronts and parks, and navigate to destinations without an address (or even street names) by using landmarks and familiar spots as visual cues.

records.rationale: The description identifies a conventional location-data service providing geographic location information for IP addresses.
evidence_spans: provides location data for IP addresses.

records.rationale: The platform provides desktop, online and mobile GIS tools for retail real-estate processes and decision support, without a specific AI capability described.
evidence_spans: using the platform that meets their needs - desktop GIS, online or mobile apps.

records.rationale: The offering is described as wireless coverage data and custom interactive coverage maps, conventional visualization and mapping services.
evidence_spans: custom interactive maps that reflect your brand style and integrate seamlessly into your current site.

records.rationale: The description only characterizes the offering as GIS solutions and provides no specific functions; best forced judgment is conventional GIS software.
evidence_spans: developing smart, simple and fast GIS solutions.

records.rationale: The described technology provides interactive street panoramas, a conventional visual mapping feature.
evidence_spans: provides interactive panoramas from positions along many streets in the world.

records.rationale: The geocoder converts address and location inputs into geographic coordinates, a conventional deterministic spatial data function.
evidence_spans: accurately coverts address and location information into geographic coordinates.

records.rationale: The description details cloud-based mapping, analysis, storage and management of geographic content, all conventional GIS functions.
evidence_spans: create, share, and manage maps, scenes, layers, apps, and other geographic content.

records.rationale: This is a postal-address database with records formatted to a recognized postal standard, conventional reference data functionality.
evidence_spans: The record set contains all data for all addresses in the United States. Each address is properly formatted in a way consistent with a standard the postal service recognizes.

records.rationale: Describes a nationwide street, address, census and postal data source for applications, conventional geospatial reference data.
evidence_spans: comprehensive nationwide street, address, census and postal data source for use in a wide variety of applications.

records.rationale: The description identifies digital maps and other location content supplied for navigation and map applications, conventional mapping and data functions.
evidence_spans: delivers digital maps and other dynamic content for navigation and location-based services, including personal and in-car navigation systems

records.rationale: The described function tracks mobile phones through network switching centers and reports locations at intervals; this is location tracking/data collection, not an AI claim.
evidence_spans: tracks all active phones in real time, anonymously and passively, to the exact street they are traveling on, pin-pointing their exact location in short intervals

records.rationale: The mobile GIS field app lets users view and edit network features, adjust attributes and track construction status, conventional record-management tasks.
evidence_spans: view, edit, and create network features from their mobile device. Users can relocate features utilizing GNSS, adjust feature attributes, reshape linear features

records.rationale: The route planner evaluates user-defined infrastructure, regulatory, geographic and cost variables to prescribe least-cost routes; this is described as constrained planning/optimization without an AI claim.
evidence_spans: looks across user-defined variables such as existing infrastructure, regulations, geographic barriers, and construction costs, then prescribes least-cost routes

records.rationale: The description covers curated map content, location data, developer tools and infrastructure in a location-data platform, conventional data and mapping capabilities.
evidence_spans: location data and technology platform empowers you to turn location data into business value quickly, efficiently and at scale.
